description:
Use this when the user asks how many NSE-listed securities advanced, declined or were unchanged on a trading day.

Returns one row per trading day with the number of NSE securities that advanced, declined and were unchanged. `from_date` and `to_date` are ISO dates at most 366 days apart; the default is the 30 days to today. By default the counts are NSE's own published figures, held from the day DalalOS began collecting them. `universe` switches to counts computed from the daily price file, which go back further: "all_series" (every listed security, including funds and bonds), "equity_sme" (shares and SME shares) or "equity" (mainboard shares only). Use "equity" when the question is about stocks.
name: get_market_breadth
title: Market breadth
